title: On Competing with three shops for custom
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：compete　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 compete 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the grower ① competed with three shops for custom twice over, and every buyer in the greenhouse said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three summers on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the grower ② competes with three shops for custom year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ compete with three shops for custom at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ competed with three shops for custom before — a line in the ledger for August 1981 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Competing with three shops for custom twice over, the grower said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ compete in the county games every year year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Compete in the county games every year at once and never mention it again.

By 1994 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new buyer from the next greenhouse ⑧ competes in the county games every year twice over every summer without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ competed with three shops for custom again when nobody else would.

⑩ To compete with three shops for custom, my mother said in 1999, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the greenhouse remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the greenhouse forgets, somebody competes with three shops for custom year after year again and somebody must compete with three shops for custom twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 竞争（一般过去式 competed with three shops for custom：1987 年种植户头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 竞争（一般现在 competes with three shops for custom：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 竞争（不定式 to compete with three shops for custom：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 竞争（过去完成时 had competed with three shops for custom：1981 年八月的收成账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 竞争（动名词 competing with three shops for custom 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 参赛（compete in the county games every year：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去参赛年年参加县里的赛事）
G. v. 参赛（compete in the county games every year：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 竞争（后段两处：新来的收购人照例 competes in the county games every year，而母亲又一次 competed with three shops for custom）

answers.why: compete 意为“竞争”，1987 年种植户来回两遍竞争与三家铺子争生意，那是大棚里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 competed。
compete 意为“竞争”，自那以后种植户年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 competes。
compete 意为“竞争”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯竞争与三家铺子争生意”，此处为不定式 to compete with three shops for custom。
compete 意为“竞争”，收成账里 八月 那行字说明早在 1994 年之前就有人竞争过，故用过去完成时 had competed。
compete 意为“竞争”，种植户说“竞争与三家铺子争生意这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 competing with three shops for custom 作主语。
compete 意为“参赛”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去参赛年年参加县里的赛事”，should ever 之后用原形 compete in the county games every year。
compete 意为“参赛”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻参赛年年参加县里的赛事（compete in the county games every year at once），以后再也不要提起。
compete 意为“竞争”，新来的收购人每个夏天都照例参赛年年参加县里的赛事，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 competes。
compete 意为“竞争”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍竞争与三家铺子争生意，用一般过去式 competed 叙述。
compete 意为“竞争”，结尾那句是母亲 1999 年的话：要竞争与三家铺子争生意，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和大棚记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 compete 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the grower competed with three shops for custom twice over, and nobody in the greenhouse forgot it.
Even now the grower competes with three shops for custom year after year whenever the greenhouse asks.
Competing with three shops for custom twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever compete in the county games every year year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new buyer from the next greenhouse competes in the county games every year twice over every summer, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother competed with three shops for custom again, and the greenhouse remembered that half.
